content.title: Single-Thread World Build | Branch, Construct, Reverse into a Mark
content.summary: Begin with one original material filament on a clearly readable substrate. Every new branch, color, structure and landscape region must grow from that still-traceable parent network; preserve junctions and paths as provenance. Escalate from macro material proof to at least three distinct but connected world regions. At peak density, reverse the same network so peripheral branches travel back along established paths and reorganize into one original short name or emblem.

quick_start.input_format: Establish one material filament and one substrate before any world appears. + Keep the parent network and every major junction traceable as branches construct new regions. + Grow at least three visually distinct regions from connected branches while sharing one substrate. + At peak density, reverse movement along already established paths instead of dissolving the world. + Resolve into one new original short name or emblem and hold it clearly.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open macro on one copper trace emerging from a graphite contact pad on a matte black circuit-board substrate; show fiber-like metal texture and one unambiguous origin before any structure appears. Rise into an oblique wide as three connected miniature districts grow: a wind-harbor, a stepped data garden and a radio observatory, all sharing the same black board and copper network. Reverse current direction: peripheral copper lines travel back along established paths, districts fold into the trace, and the same material reorganizes into the original short mark GRIDMINT; hold cleanly with no source logo or wording.

usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Begin with one original material filament on a clearly readable substrate. Every new branch, color, structure and landscape region must grow from that still-traceable parent network; preserve junctions and paths as provenance. Escalate from macro material proof to at least three distinct but connected world regions. Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Begin with one original material filament on a clearly readable substrate. Every new branch, color, structure and landscape region must grow from that still-traceable parent network; preserve junctions and paths as provenance. Escalate from macro material proof to at least three distinct but connected world regions. At peak density, reverse the same network so peripheral branches travel back along established paths and reorganize into one original short name or emblem. The reusable mechanism is single-origin material proof, branching construction, connected regional escalation, reverse collection and wordmark resolution—not the source textile, colors, castles, terrains, logo, creator name, exact camera or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one material filament and one substrate before any world appears.
invariants.purpose: Provides a physical origin for every later element.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple unexplained sources turn construction into arbitrary morphing.

invariants.rule: Keep the parent network and every major junction traceable as branches construct new regions.
invariants.ablation_failure: Hidden cuts make the world look pre-existing rather than built.

invariants.rule: Grow at least three visually distinct regions from connected branches while sharing one substrate.
invariants.ablation_failure: One repeated region cannot prove the construction system is reusable.

invariants.rule: At peak density, reverse movement along already established paths instead of dissolving the world.
invariants.purpose: Makes the return causally symmetric with the build.
invariants.ablation_failure: A generic fade loses material conservation.

invariants.rule: Resolve into one new original short name or emblem and hold it clearly.
invariants.purpose: Converts complexity into a legible identity payoff.
invariants.ablation_failure: Copying the source name or ending on loose threads fails the transfer.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source dark cloth, thread colors, weave and embroidery texture
source castles, mountains, desert, snow, rivers and exact terrain layout
source branching paths, construction order and exact camera climb
source creator name, Koda-like wordmark and logo geometry
source MiniMax H3 wording, timing and creator identity
